content_sections.heading: AMCH Technical Coordinator Job Description
content_sections.text: Act as a focal point for Rare Disease Clinic as the CoEs. Provide technical and strategic support for planning, coordination and implementation of rare disease-related activities. Coordinate with clinical departments for diagnosis, investigations and formulation of treatment plans. Facilitate documentation, application review and approval process for patient support. Liaise with MoHFW, State Governments, and other stakeholders for fund disbursement and compliance. Coordinating with the spokes in matters of proposal for equipment and consumables procurement, demand for funds, submission of utilization certificates etc. Track drug procurement and ensure timely availability and logistics for therapy. Guide and monitor ABHA ID generation and digital health record maintenance. Ensure timely and accurate data reporting and analytics for MoHFW and interval reviews. Organize capacity-building sessions, trainings and awareness program at the CoE. Develop and disseminate IEC materials and media content for public and stakeholder awareness. Support development of treatment guidelines, SOPs, and other technical documentation. Manage patient data and regularly update the Rare Disease Registry and associated digital platforms. Assist in preparation of reports, summaries, and digital dashboards. Maintain proper patient records in both digital and physical formats, ensuring confidentiality. Provide counselling, guidance, and continuous support to rare disease patients and their caregivers.
